newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Lung sets HK$500 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Wing Lung sets HK$500 mln FRCD.

text.p: Wing Lung Bank Ltd has launched a HK$500 million floating-rate certificates of deposit issue, bankers said.
It will be completed on a "club" basis, they said.
The five-year certificates feature put and call options at the end of years three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for participants is expected to be 50 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Jardine Fleming Bank and Schroders Asia are the arrangers for the deal.
The issue is off the bank's HK$3.0 billion CD programme.
Wing Lung is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investor Services and BBB-pi by Standard and Poor's Corp.
